allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: We enclose herewith the disclosures under aforementioned regulation received from members belonging to the promoter / promoter group pursuant to the allotment of equity shares  under the Scheme of Amalgamation

allot.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
allot.text: This is to inform that the Working Committee at their meeting held today i.e., April 23, 2025 have inter-alia approved allotment of 1,13,71,870 new equity shares of Rs.10/- each fully paid-up to eligible shareholders of REVL / RBL in accordance with the approved Share exchange ratio. The meeting of the Working Committee of Board commenced at 19:20 hrs (IST) and concluded at 19:40 hrs (IST).
